title: Implement deterministic offline AI harness task lifecycle
objective: Add deterministic local Harness lifecycle operations that derive runnable work from dependency-complete tasks, fail closed on missing independent-audit evidence, and atomically keep task specs and the ledger in sync. The implementation must be an offline planner and verifier only; it must not invoke AO, agents, providers, or credentials.
forbidden_actions: Do not call Agent Orchestrator, agents, model gateways, network APIs, browsers, providers, package registries, credentials, or external commands other than the declared local acceptance commands.
Do not automatically mark a task GREEN, DONE, READY, or otherwise change a task state without a matching verified local manifest and declared dependency state.

Do not treat an implementer run as an independent audit, bypass auditor-agent identity separation, weaken T2/T3 gates, or alter Solana, BSC, Robinhood, macro, provider, database, or business-code behavior.
Do not add secrets, environment files, or executable live-operation configuration.
